RC1 · A REVIEW COPY FOR A JOURNALIST

Dear reader, would you read two chapters?

From the editor of The ultimate insider, a book about one day in which one person and a team of AI agents built a talk, with the record to prove it.

Why you
You check before you believe. Every claim in these chapters points at a public record; if one does not hold, or a failure is told too kindly, you are the reader who will say so.
What we would like
Two chapters, about 30 minutes, by Friday 13 November 2026 (an example date: nothing has been sent), and your answers to a few questions at the end of each.
What you get back
your name in the acknowledgements, if you want it there
the first edition when it ships
a reply to every comment, and a page showing what your comments changed
